message: Vector Rebel 3.2.79: C shift shared PPE pilot status in User and battalion-style Master; native Item Log completion receipts sent to Rebel Command.
releaseNotes: C-shift-only pilot with seven approved firefighters. Regular User interface keeps five core buttons and adds a compact C Shift Gear Status crew view; Master adds a Shift Gear Check view. Authenticated Rebel Command board stores an item ledger and shows last actual ledger update. Verified newly completed native Item Log +1 receipts from Tour PPE are queued durably, reported to RC and acknowledged before removal. Only known discovered gear is tracked; no false full-inventory or attendance certification. Recheck schedule 7am-noon every 2 min, noon-7am hourly is policy only: unattended Vector browsing and background native rechecks are not yet connected.
